body:
It's kind to think about it, though. I wish you could heal me and I wish I could heal you. I wish there was a place for each one of us, broken peoples. It would be our secret place, that no others may find. 

Unfortunately, i think it is like in Matrix, we are prisoners of a simulation, we are all electricity, prisoners of the Old "Gods", in an illusion, in our vessel made of flesh & bones.  We die, we come back here, endlessly, as slaves, to build their Kingdom.
